capabilities: search the vault for matching lines
show each match with its parent and nested children based on indentation
render results with Obsidian's Markdown renderer
jump to the matched line or open it in a new tab with keyboard shortcuts
configure result limits, case sensitivity, excluded folders and indentation handling
extras: Part of the author's suite of offline-focused plugins (DoomEsque theme, Task Docket, Inline Autocomplete, etc.). README states an automated offline-audit script verifies zero network calls; manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. For fully offline exam use it advises also disabling Obsidian's Sync, Publish and automatic updates.
motivation: The author built it as part of a suite guaranteed to make zero network requests, so it can safely be used for notes during open-book law exams.
problem: Obsidian's standard search shows only the isolated matching line, losing which project or task a line belongs to and which subtasks sit beneath it in outlines.
summary: Search plugin that shows each matched line together with its parent item and all nested children reconstructed from list indentation.
